title: Looking for Forex Traders and Developers to Collaborate on an Open-Source Trading Bot
author: naughty_kizaru

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: I'd build the backtest and paper side before the telegram alerts and the dashboard. those are the fun weekend parts, and it's easy to end up with a nice dashboard for a strategy nobody has tested against real spreads yet.

replies.author: naughty_kizaru
replies.body:
Thanks for the advice! I appreciate it. Honestly, I'm not a coder, haha. I just had this idea and wanted to work on something interesting, so I'm taking help from Claude to build it step by step and learn along the way.

I'll definitely focus on the backtesting and paper trading side first before moving on to the alerts and dashboard. Appreciate you pointing me in the right direction!

I'll upload whatever I build to GitHub and send you the repo link here in chat once it's ready. Thanks again for the help!
